defiMaturation.statement: DeFi is progressively becoming a more mature and investable domain with observable protocol businesses and cash-flow/value-capture mechanisms, not merely speculative tokens.

businessAnalysisPreference.statement: Productive DeFi should increasingly be analyzed using business/investment concepts such as fees, revenue, holder value capture, emissions, TVL, activity, profitability, security, governance and company-attributable cash flow.

tradfiDefiConvergence.statement: Traditional finance is progressively moving onto blockchain rails and more real-world financial assets are being tokenized.

companyConstruction.statement: The Holding should use layered capital architecture and professional investment/business analysis to construct long-lived companies rather than behave as a token-trading system.

externallyVerifiedEvidence.supports: active tooling exists for token cash-flow, value-capture and holder-revenue analysis
tokenized securities are a formally recognized securities representation model under current SEC guidance
major traditional asset managers are launching tokenized fund structures using blockchain infrastructure
institutional firms have explored tokenized portfolio construction and management across traditional and alternative assets
BlackRock operates a tokenized institutional liquidity fund with official onchain token addresses

unverifiedOrBoundedClaims.claim: large funds broadly develop their own DeFi indexes
DeFi as a whole now consists of real businesses
unverifiedOrBoundedClaims.safeInterpretation: a growing subset of protocols exposes measurable operating and value-capture economics

roles.purpose: productive DeFi and recurring onchain cash flow
productive stable liquidity and operational resilience
tokenized real-world income and diversifying assets

holdingArchitecture.corePrinciple: judge assets by economic function and capital-layer fit before judging them as a universal buy-or-avoid category

requiredQuestions: what real economic activity generates value
what gross fees or revenues are produced
what exact portion accrues to the company position
how much is organic versus emission-subsidized
how volume TVL users and liquidity are trending
how company yield and cash flow respond
whether value capture is improving or deteriorating
what security governance dilution and liquidity risks exist
whether the asset still fits its assigned capital layer
